relations.subject: Dungkar Lozang Trinlé
relations.object: Kongpo Kantseng, Mé Dratsang, Sera Monastery
relations.evidence: Thereafter he entered Kongpo Kantseng, Mé Dratsang (college) in Sera Monastery... He received the Geshé Lharampa degree in that year

relations.subject: Dungkar Lozang Trinlé
relations.evidence: The Venerable Ngawang Yönten became his teacher, and he studied the “Five Great Books."

relations.subject: Dungkar Lozang Trinlé
relations.evidence: Obtained the ngakrampa (sngags rams pa) degree in Tantric studies from the Gyuto Tantric College.

relations.subject: Dungkar Lozang Trinlé
relations.evidence: Up to the end of 1965, he was a teacher of Tibetan language at China's Central Institute for Nationalities in Beijing.

relations.subject: Dungkar Lozang Trinlé
relations.evidence: Awarded full professor position at China's Central Institute for Nationalities in Beijing.

relations.subject: Dungkar Lozang Trinlé
relations.evidence: Appointed Director of the Tibet Academy of Social Sciences in Lhasa.

relations.subject: Dungkar Lozang Trinlé
relations.evidence: At the age of 70 years old, he was offered retirement from Tibet University in Lhasa.
